title: cicuta graeca
intro: Cicuta graeca, commonly known as Hellebore of Greece, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cicuta graeca include acting as an expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, helping to relieve respiratory issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, such as helleborin and hellebrin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
